study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
outcome: Preeclampsia with severe features (PE-SF) within two weeks of triage visit
cohort: 1043 pregnant patients suspected of preeclampsia at >=20 weeks gestation.
finding: The sFlt1/PlGF ratio was a useful tool for predicting preeclampsia with severe features within two weeks, with performance varying by the presence of hypertension and gestational age.
